description: This Java class 'HelloWorldLaunchPerformance' extends 'LaunchPerformanceBase' and is used for launch performance testing of an Android application. It sets up the intent to launch the 'HelloWorld' activity and manages the test lifecycle with 'onCreate' and 'onStart' methods.

classes.name: HelloWorldLaunchPerformance
classes.description: An instrumentation class for launch performance testing of the 'HelloWorld' activity in an Android app.

methods.name: HelloWorldLaunchPerformance
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class and invokes the superclass constructor.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the onCreate method to set up the intent targeting the HelloWorld activity and start the test.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides onStart to launch the app and finish the test with a result code.
